reasoning.overall: Bayern travel to Wolfsburg three days after the high-stakes CL semi-final 2nd leg vs PSG, with the Bundesliga title already secured on matchday 30 (4-2 vs Stuttgart, 19 April). Kompany is virtually certain to rotate heavily — the CL final is May 30 if they advance, and Bayern have set scoring records this season but also showed defensive vulnerability conceding 5 to PSG. Wolfsburg are 17th, fighting relegation, leak goals (3-6 vs Leverkusen, 1-1 Freiburg, 0-0 Gladbach, 4-3 loss vs Freiburg earlier), and play at the Volkswagen Arena where they at least have three undefeated home games. The first leg was an 8-1 Bayern rout but featured a Wolfsburg goal and several first-half chances. Even rotated, Bayern have superior depth (Karl, Bischof, Goretzka, Guerreiro, Jackson, Mike, Chavez, Davies returning) and Wolfsburg's leaky back line creates strong xG asymmetry. Expect an open, end-to-end Bundesliga finale rather than a tight tactical battle.
reasoning.t1_result: Bayern remain heavy favourites even rotated — squad gap is enormous and Wolfsburg's defence concedes 1.8+ per game. But rotation, Bayern's recent defensive lapses and Wolfsburg playing for survival at home support meaningful draw mass and a non-trivial home upset path; goal-fest scorelines are realistic.
reasoning.t2_player: Bayern likely roll out a B+ XI: Urbig in goal to rest Neuer; Stanišić/Laimer flanking Upamecano-Tah; Goretzka and Bischof in midfield; Karl, Musiala (if fully fit) and Díaz behind Jackson, with Kane rested for the CL final. Wolfsburg in 4-2-3-1: Grabara; Kumbedi-Jenz-Koulierakis-Fischer; Arnold-Vinícius Souza; Wimmer-Eriksen-Majer; Amoura back from AFCON leading the line ahead of Pejčinović.
reasoning.t3_events: Open game with goals across both halves; Bayern likely score early through Díaz/Olise off transitions, Wolfsburg push at home and find one through Amoura/Pejčinović or set-piece, then Bayern's depth tells late. Cards likely on Wolfsburg pressers (Svanberg-type tactical fouls), at least 4-5 yellows total, multiple subs around 60-70'.
reasoning.t4_stats: Bayern dominate possession (~62%) and pass accuracy; Wolfsburg generate fewer but decent shots from transition (10-12). Expect Bayern 16-19 shots, 6-8 on target, more corners. Wolfsburg likely commit more fouls. Saves elevated for Grabara given Bayern's volume.
